effects: Pulls `amount` ENA (the vault's collateral, 0x57e1…6061) from the signer into the vault with safeTransferFrom; this uses the signer's existing ENA allowance to the vault.
Mints active vault shares worth the deposited ENA to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer. That stake can be slashed and only `onBehalfOf` can withdraw it.
Reverts when deposit whitelisting is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or when the deposit limit would be passed. Neither changes the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Deposit X ENA into the vault for the named beneficiary, with the vault, the ENA amount and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares credited to onBehalfOf is not shown; the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)`. The value comes from storage and is not in the calldata.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The ENA amount and the beneficiary already describe the position.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` ENA, rounding up.
Moves `amount` ENA of the signer's stake into the next epoch's withdrawal queue and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it after the epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call. The queued amount can still be slashed before it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request X ENA withdrawal for the claimer, with the vault, the ENA amount and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and possible slashing before the claim are not shown; both come from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. onSlash lowers `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`, so the amount claimed later can be smaller than the amount requested.
findings.fix: None needed in the fields. The intent could say the withdrawal is claimable after the current epoch ends.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the ENA value of those shares, previewRedeem rounded down, for the next epoch and credits it to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it after the epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call. The queued amount can be slashed before it is claimed.
formats.shown: Queue N raw shares for the claimer, with the vault, the raw share count and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer, so a person cannot read it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: `#.shares` uses format `raw` ('Vault shares (raw)'); case 2 shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18-decimal scale.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {decimals: 18, base: "shares"} so the field reads like '0.9877 shares'.

findings.title: redeem: the ENA amount queued for the claimer is not shown; the contract computes it from shares.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())`, which comes from storage.

effects: Sends ENA to `recipient`: the full amount the signer is owed for `epoch` (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)).
Marks the signer's claim for that epoch as used, so it cannot be claimed again.
formats.shown: Claim epoch N to the recipient, with the vault, the epoch number and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says ENA is what goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. Nothing names the asset.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim ENA withdrawal' and 'Claim ENA from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the ENA amount sent is read from storage and is not in the calldata.

effects: Sends ENA to `recipient`: the sum of the signer's withdrawable amounts for every listed epoch, in one transfer.
Marks the signer's claim for each listed epoch as used.
formats.shown: Claim the listed epochs to the recipient, with the vault, each epoch number and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says ENA is what goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim ENA withdrawals' and 'Claim ENA from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total ENA sent is read from storage and is not in the calldata.

redeem(address claimer,uint256 shares).worst: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer, so a person cannot read it.

claim(address recipient,uint256 epoch).worst: claim: the screen never says ENA is what goes to the recipient.

claimBatch(address recipient,uint256[] e.worst: claimBatch: the screen never says ENA is what goes to the recipient.
